provenance.source_title: The Economics Of Owning A Shopping Mall

examples.psychological_goal: 用第二人称邀约锁定有收租幻想的观众
examples.expression_mechanism: 资产邀约（So you want to buy X）
examples.example_text: Okay, so you want to buy a shopping mall,
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'你想买X'直接开场，X选大众以为'躺着收租'的资产
examples.negative_instruction: X必须是观众自认为理解的资产

examples.psychological_goal: 用两个短句的冷否定截断观众的幻想
examples.expression_mechanism: 先扬后抑冷幽默（Sounds simple. It is not simple.）
examples.example_text: Sounds simple. It is not simple.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用重复句式的直接否定做开场急刹
examples.negative_instruction: 否定后必须立刻给出'复杂在哪'的预告

examples.psychological_goal: 把收购对象从不动产重定义为赌注
examples.expression_mechanism: 对象重定义（not a building, a bet on X）
examples.example_text: you're not really buying a building, you're buying a bet on a neighborhood
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'你买的不真是X，是对Y的赌注'重置观众的产权认知
examples.negative_instruction: 赌注标的（社区）必须能被前文案例（等级鸿沟）支撑

examples.psychological_goal: 用日常价格对照让金融结构瞬间可感
examples.expression_mechanism: 日常价格类比（for the price of a cup of coffee）
examples.example_text: Ordinary investors can buy shares in a mall owning REIT on the stock market for the price of a cup of coffee
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用一杯咖啡的价格解释证券化门槛
examples.negative_instruction: 类比只用于说明门槛，不要暗示收益

examples.psychological_goal: 用'两个日子'的对照让隐性条款显形
examples.expression_mechanism: 时间对照（not on the day you buy, the day X leaves）
examples.example_text: You don't see this cost on the day you buy the mall. You see it the day your anchor tenant leaves.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'你在A日看不到它，在B日看到它'揭示延迟爆发的成本
examples.negative_instruction: B日的触发机制（主力店离开）必须先交代

examples.psychological_goal: 用1/10的悬殊比例撕开'面积大=租金高'的直觉
examples.expression_mechanism: 悬殊比例对照（1/10 what the small shop pays）
examples.example_text: was paying roughly 1/10 what the little clothing shop next door was paying per square foot.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用最大与最小租户的单价比例制造震惊
examples.negative_instruction: 比例必须有真实租约研究支撑

examples.psychological_goal: 用方向反转重定义主力店租约的本质
examples.expression_mechanism: 租赁方向反转（renting TO vs renting FROM）
examples.example_text: The mall owner isn't renting square footage to the anchor. The mall owner is renting foot traffic from the anchor,
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'不是把X租给A，是从A租来Y'颠覆交易方向
examples.negative_instruction: 反转后必须解释支付形式（租金折扣）

examples.psychological_goal: 用花车案例证明位置定价逻辑
examples.example_text: often charge extremely high rent per square foot because they take up almost no space and sit exactly where foot traffic is heaviest.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用最小租体的极端单价反证'位置>面积'
examples.negative_instruction: 案例参数（不到100平方英尺/必经之路）要具体

examples.psychological_goal: 用对偶金句给花车悖论定性
examples.example_text: Size and rent, in other words, are not the same thing in this business. Position is worth more than space.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'X和Y不是一回事，Z比X值钱'的两步宣判
examples.negative_instruction: 金句必须紧跟案例，不要空放

examples.psychological_goal: 用一个照常运转的画面解释固定成本刚性
examples.expression_mechanism: 照常运转细节（hallways still need cleaning）
examples.example_text: The hallways still need to be cleaned whether every store beside them is occupied or not.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'无论有无租户都照常'的具体画面解释固定成本
examples.negative_instruction: 细节必须指向后文的螺旋机制（分摊给更少人）

examples.psychological_goal: 用七个词拆掉最被迷信的经营指标
examples.expression_mechanism: 指标拆穿（X is not the same thing as Y）
examples.example_text: Occupancy is not the same thing as income.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习直接否定一个行业常用指标的解释力
examples.negative_instruction: 否定前必须先展示'90%满租仍亏钱'的组合陷阱

examples.psychological_goal: 用延迟正题的方式插入一段历史设计课
examples.expression_mechanism: 延迟正题预告（before we get to X, understand Y）
examples.example_text: Before we get to how malls die, it's worth understanding something that mall developers figured out decades ago
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在大揭秘前先插入一段'理解这个才能懂那个'的前置课
examples.negative_instruction: 前置课必须与正题强相关（设计逻辑解释死亡机制）

examples.psychological_goal: 用一句话给出建筑设计的商业逻辑
examples.example_text: Force movement and you increase exposure, and exposure is what the smaller tenants are actually paying for
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把空间设计翻译成'谁在为哪个中间产物付钱'
examples.negative_instruction: 链条的每一环都要有前文设计细节支撑

examples.psychological_goal: 重定义失败模式：不是普遍性衰退，是依赖性崩塌
examples.expression_mechanism: 失败机制重定义（one piece falls out, structure depended on it）
examples.example_text: It fails because one piece falls out and the rest of the structure was quietly built to depend on that piece staying in place.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'不是X而死，是Y'的句式纠正对失败的归因
examples.negative_instruction: '依赖'必须已被前文具体机制（cotenancy）证明

examples.psychological_goal: 用时间跨度让崩塌速度可感
examples.expression_mechanism: 时间压缩（less than two decades from 98% to rubble）
examples.example_text: It took less than two decades to go from that number to a pile of rubble and a warehouse.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'从巅峰数字到废墟只用N年'压缩生命周期
examples.negative_instruction: 巅峰数字必须在前文锚定（98%满租）

examples.psychological_goal: 用'存在理由失效'解释行业级死亡
examples.expression_mechanism: 存在理由失效（reason for existing stopped being unique）
examples.example_text: The mall's original reason for existing, convenience, simply stopped being unique to malls.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先命名一门生意的原始产品（便利），再宣布它不再独有
examples.negative_instruction: 原始产品必须是可论证的真实价值主张

examples.psychological_goal: 用'卖X→卖Y'的转向定义幸存者策略
examples.expression_mechanism: 产品重定位（used to sell X, survivors sell Y）
examples.example_text: A mall used to sell products. The malls that survived started selling reasons to physically leave the house.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'过去卖X，幸存者卖Y'概括行业转型
examples.negative_instruction: Y必须有具体清单（餐饮/医疗/娱乐）支撑

examples.psychological_goal: 用主语对调总结双情景的变量来源
examples.expression_mechanism: 表层/底层对调（building didn't, economics did）
examples.example_text: The building didn't change. The economics underneath it did.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'表层没变，底层变了'解释同一资产的两种命运
examples.negative_instruction: 对调必须基于双情景的完整对比

examples.psychological_goal: 用'X不是生意，Y才是'给全片封箱
examples.expression_mechanism: 终极主语重定义（the people are the business）
examples.example_text: The building isn't really the business. The people walking through it are.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在结尾把资产重定义为流经它的人
examples.negative_instruction: 重定义必须回收前文全部机制（客流=收入=曝光）
